description: This Java source file defines an abstract class for Cassandra-based time series data access objects, including methods for converting database rows to key-value entries and handling time series data entries.

classes.name: AbstractCassandraBaseTimeseriesDao
classes.description: An abstract DAO class for Cassandra time series data, providing conversion utilities and constants.

methods.name: toKvEntry
methods.description: Converts a Cassandra Row to a KvEntry based on the value type.

methods.name: convertResultToTsKvEntryList
methods.description: Converts a list of Rows to a list of TsKvEntry objects.

methods.name: convertResultToTsKvEntry
methods.description: Converts a single Row to a TsKvEntry with key and timestamp.

methods.name: convertResultToTsKvEntry
methods.description: Converts a key and Row to a TsKvEntry, or returns a default entry if Row is null.

methods.name: convertResultToTsKvEntryOpt
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing TsKvEntry from a Row, or empty if Row is null.

methods.name: getBasicTsKvEntry
methods.description: Creates a BasicTsKvEntry from a key and Row, extracting timestamp and key.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Safely retrieves the key string from a Row, handling exceptions.
